title: I hate waiting for tests +without knowing how long they'll take
author: castor44_
selftext:
My tests take a long time. What bugged me most was watching them run with no idea how long was left.

When I got the email about Claude Code mods, I had no clue what to use them for. Then I found one by accident: I complained, and Claude wrote a mod. Now while tests run, there's one line above the prompt textarea.

It works with any test runner. To install it, drop the folder into .claude/, or just ask Claude to install it following the README.

Download: [https://filedn.eu/lw6Bib7ncGx5AvKTWFt3Iom/claude-test-progress.zip](https://filedn.eu/lw6Bib7ncGx5AvKTWFt3Iom/claude-test-progress.zip)
